thread:
maria: Heads up — after the firmware push last night some nodes in us-west2 are failing the serial console handoff. A few of them also show secure boot toggled to ENABLED, which is causing kexec fallbacks during provisioning. Not widespread but hits multiple racks.
ben: Noted. Any pattern on hardware families or BIOS versions?
maria: Mostly r5-gpu-48 racks, BIOS 2.4.7 -> 2.4.8 delta. BMCs reported as reachable but the console session dies right after kernel load starts.
alex: Can you paste the serial log snippet? Also pinging @infra-bot to surface current rollout state.
maria: Sure — sample from rack-r5-12 node-04:
```
[  1.234567] Kernel panic - not syncing: attempted kexec while secure boot enforced
[  1.234580] EFI: SecureBoot: enabled
[  1.234593] Rebooting in 10 seconds...
``` 
maria: BMC shows: `bios_flags: applied=0x0 expected=0x1` and `last_fw_commit: 2026-03-19T23:02:11Z`
infra-bot: Firmware rollout status: 86% complete in us-west2, pause requested by deployer. Affected nodes: 12 (r5-gpu-48). Auto-rollback: disabled.
priya: If secure boot flips on during BIOS apply we need to avoid kexec paths. Suggest holding provisioning and doing a targeted reflash to 2.4.7 on affected nodes.
ben: Agree. Also want a short-term workaround: add an extra initrd hook to skip kexec when EFI SecureBoot is enabled, and force a graceful reboot after a delay. Less ideal but buys time.
alex: For triage I ran `rifctl bmc get --node rack-r5-12-node-04 --fields=secure_boot,bios_version,console_state` — result: `secure_boot: enabled, bios_version: 2.4.8, console_state: partially-open`.
ben: Who owns the rollback? @maria can you queue the reflash playbook for those 12 nodes and mark them exempt from autoscaler until confirmed healthy?
maria: On it. I'll kick the playbook and attach the job id here. Running in batches of 3.

maria: playbook job: fb-20260319-09 (batch-1 started)
ben: I'll add the initrd patch to the provisioning image and stage it in the artifact repo. Link when ready.
priya: After we stabilize, let's update the rollout checklist to include a secure-boot sanity check step (pre-apply) and a BMC echo verification post-apply.
alex: FYI — networking team reported small mgmt plane latency spike at 23:05 which lines up with the moment most toggles happened. Could be related to lost BMC handshake messages.
ben: Good catch. I'll coordinate with networking to review switch logs; may need a retry/backoff in our BMC flasher.
infra-bot: Reminder: open incident created: INC-2026-0319-14. Pager duty: eng-infra on-call rotated to ben.
maria: Thanks team — will update thread as batches finish. If you see nodes re-provision successfully ping here. :thumbsup:
